_doc: All use_action type IDs registered in GameManager._ready() and their parameter schemas. Context is the object or inventory item being used.

use_action_types._doc: Opens or closes a door/gate WorldObject. No params needed.

params.message: optional string — message to post after triggering

use_action_types._doc: Triggers all objects listed in the WorldObject's 'targets' array.
Opens or closes a container, spilling its contents when opened.
Applies a modifier from modifiers.json to the player stat block.

params.message: optional string — message to post after consuming

use_action_types._doc: Removes the item from inventory (or world) after use.
Changes the player's standing with a faction.
Decrements one charge on the item/object; removes it when charges reach zero.
Displays the item's readable text via MessageLog.
Toggles a carried or placed light source on or off.
Teaches the player the spell_id stored on the scroll WorldObject.
Attempts to unlock a locked object using a matching key in inventory.
Attempts to pick a lock using a lockpick from inventory.

params.effects: Array of effect entries (same structure as spell effects in spells.json)

use_action_types._doc: Executes a list of spell effects from the item's use_actions.params.
Deals damage to the player or a target based on the formula.
